ourStory.title: 1983 to today — craft that families rely on.
paragraphs: We started crafting jewellery in 1983 at Santh Bazzar, Nadiad — gold and silver work done by skilled karigars, one piece at a time.
Over four decades we have served more than 100 families — as wholesaler to jewellers and retailers, and as a retail counter where you can walk in, call, or message us on WhatsApp.
That dual role still defines us: wholesale discipline on purity and weight, retail warmth at the counter, and the same gold-and-silver craftsmanship whether you order one ring or a full bridal set.
